definitions: Catch or tear (something) on a sharp projection.
Catch (a fish) with a hook by accident rather than by enticing it to bite.
Obtain, catch, or get (something) quickly or unexpectedly.
examples: She snagged her new jumper on a rose thorn.
He snagged a large salmon while reeling in his line.
I managed to snag a couple of tickets for the concert.
